start-desc: Classic 9×9 logic puzzles. No sign-up, no ads, everything saved on your device.
daily-desc: A new puzzle every day, the same for everyone. Solve every day of a month to earn its trophy.
no-trophies: Solve every day of a month to earn its trophy.
new-warn: Your current game will be lost.
over-text: You made 3 mistakes, so this game is lost.
complete-wrong: The board is full, but some numbers are wrong.
no-hints: No hints left for this game.
hint-wrong: That number was wrong: the {n} goes here.
hint-naked: Only {n} fits in this cell: every other number is already in its row, column or box.
hint-hidden-row: {n} can only go in this cell within its row.
hint-hidden-col: {n} can only go in this cell within its column.
hint-hidden-box: {n} can only go in this cell within its 3×3 box.
hint-advanced: A tricky one: once pairs and pointing numbers rule out other cells, only {n} fits here.
reset-confirm: Reset all statistics? This can't be undone.
s-autocheck-d: Mark wrong numbers in red as soon as you enter them
s-area-d: Shade the row, column and box of the selected cell
s-same-d: Shade every cell with the same number
s-dup-d: Mark numbers that clash in a row, column or box
s-autonotes-d: When you place a number, remove it from notes in the same row, column and box
s-timer-d: Hide it if the clock stresses you out
data-desc: Progress is stored only in this browser. Export it to move it to another device.
import-bad: That file isn't a sudoku save.
r1: Fill every row, column and 3×3 box with the numbers 1 to 9, each exactly once.
r2: Tap a cell, then a number. Turn on Notes to pencil in the numbers a cell could be.
r3: Every puzzle has exactly one solution and can be solved by logic alone, no guessing.
r4: Each correct number scores points, more on harder levels. Finishing a row, column or box adds a bonus, and so does a fast finish with no mistakes.
